card.situation:
Combined Synopsis/Solicitation for non-personal exterior landscape maintenance services at the National Weather Service Weather Forecast Office, St. Charles, MO — base year (active services award through 10/31/2026) plus three option years through 02/28/2030, awarded low-price/technically-acceptable, total small business set-aside.
Reached the owner because NAICS 561730 matches exactly, the firm is SBA/WOSB-eligible, and past performance at Tinker AFB (grounds maintenance, mowing, trimming, irrigation, herbicide) aligns with core scope — but two owner rules (distance and base-period length) are flagged as disqualifying conflicts.
reasons_for: NAICS 561730 is an exact match and the firm is fully eligible for the total small business set-aside as a WOSB/EDWOSB/SBA-registered entity [set_aside_note: ELIGIBLE].

Tinker AFB grounds maintenance past performance (mowing, trimming, irrigation, herbicide application) directly maps to the core SOW requirements for mowing height, edging, weed control, and sprinkler maintenance [fbaa93b9-91f354c4-p1-c0a31670].

Fit score of 0.80 with 20 of 36 requirements fully met and only 2 gaps indicates strong technical alignment on the majority of deliverables [matrix_summary: 20 of 36 requirements met, 8 partial, 2 gap, 6 unknown].
reasons_against: Place of performance is St. Charles, MO (~750 miles from Oklahoma City, OK), directly violating owner rule rc-distance which caps pursuit at a 200-mile radius [fbaa93b9-94c5bc7c-p30-66deb694; owner rule rc-distance: 200-mile limit].

The active base-period service window is only ~2 months (award through 10/31/2026), triggering a disqualifying conflict with owner rule rc-base requiring a minimum 12-month base period [fbaa93b9-94c5bc7c-p2-69f3be6a; owner rule rc-base: No bids under a 12-month base period].

No Missouri pesticide/herbicide applicator license is confirmed in the firm profile, creating a hard compliance gap against the solicitation's mandatory certification requirement for all employees handling herbicides [fbaa93b9-91f354c4-p1-6061f089].

drafts.capability_statement:
Red Cedar Facility Services is a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) and Economically Disadvantaged Woman-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB) registered under NAICS 561730 (Landscaping Services), the exact code cited in this solicitation. We are fully eligible under the Total Small Business Set-Aside.

Red Cedar provides comprehensive exterior grounds maintenance for federal and state facilities, self-performing all mowing, trimming, edging, irrigation system maintenance, herbicide and weed control, and fertilization. We furnish all labor, supervision, equipment, tools, and supplies — no government-furnished property required. Our quality control program uses a CMMS to log every site inspection, and our supervisors hold OSHA 30 certifications to ensure safe, compliant operations on occupied federal premises.

Our past performance includes a grounds maintenance contract at Tinker Air Force Base (72nd Air Base Wing), where we maintained cantonment-area turf, performed herbicide applications, and managed irrigation systems under federal contract requirements. We have also performed custodial and facility services at GSA- and VA-managed properties, demonstrating our ability to operate within federal security and conduct-of-work requirements.

Red Cedar's green cleaning and biobased product program aligns directly with the USDA BioPreferred preference stated in this solicitation. Our 38 W-2 employees support staffing continuity across multi-year performance periods.

We are prepared to submit a detailed technical approach, a work plan within seven days of award, and completed representations and certifications with our quote. Point of contact: [Name, Title, Phone, Email].
questions_for_co: Regarding the pesticide/herbicide applicator certification requirement [fbaa93b9-91f354c4-p1-6061f089]: will the government accept a Missouri-issued pesticide applicator license obtained by the contractor after award but before the first herbicide application, or must proof of licensure be submitted with the quote?

Regarding SAM.gov registration [fbaa93b9-591fc7d8-p2-94bfa3f7; fbaa93b9-94c5bc7c-p5-4664fc4d; fbaa93b9-94c5bc7c-p33-703245c1]: is it sufficient for the quoter's SAM registration to be active at the time of award, or must it be confirmed active at the time of quote submission?

Regarding the Department of Commerce security processing and fingerprinting requirement [fbaa93b9-94c5bc7c-p21-1eea0f66]: how many employees are expected to require fingerprinting and Credit Release Authorization, and what is the typical processing timeline through the Servicing Security Officer and OPM so we can plan mobilization accordingly?

Regarding NAO 202-1106 sexual assault and sexual harassment prevention training [fbaa93b9-94c5bc7c-p24-ccba2096]: does the government provide the required training materials or a government-approved course, or is the contractor responsible for sourcing a compliant training program independently?

Regarding Invoice Processing Platform (IPP) registration [fbaa93b9-94c5bc7c-p25-5a1aeab2]: is IPP enrollment completed after award, and does the contracting office provide onboarding guidance, or must the contractor be enrolled in IPP prior to quote submission?

Regarding the base period active service window [fbaa93b9-94c5bc7c-p2-69f3be6a]: the solicitation states active services run only from date of award through 10/31/2026 in the base period — can the contracting officer confirm the anticipated award date so quoters can accurately price the number of service visits in the base period?

reader.scope_summary: The government is buying non-personal exterior landscape maintenance services at the National Weather Service Weather Forecast Office located at 12 Research Park Drive, St. Charles, MO 63304. The contractor must provide all labor, tools, equipment, supervision, herbicides, transportation and any other products or services necessary, to maintain the landscaping and grounds in such a manner as to present a neat and well-maintained appearance. The contract consists of a base year (services only from award through 10/31/2026) plus three option years, each with active services running March 1 through October 31, for a potential total of approximately five years.
reader.evaluation_basis: The Government intends to award a low priced, technically acceptable, single firm fixed-price purchase order on an all or none basis with payment terms of Net 30.
reader.incumbent_or_history: THE INCUMBENT CONTRACT WAS AWARDED TO BLCS LLC FOR AN AGGREGATE OF $28,387.00 FOR FIVE (5) YEARS.
quotes: THE INCUMBENT CONTRACT WAS AWARDED TO BLCS LLC FOR AN AGGREGATE OF $28,387.00 FOR FIVE (5) YEARS.
The Government intends to award a low priced, technically acceptable, single firm fixed-price purchase order on an all or none basis with payment terms of Net 30.

The Contractor must provide all labor, tools, equipment, supervision, herbicides, transportation and any other products or services necessary, to maintain the landscaping and grounds in such a manner as to present a neat and well-maintained appearance.
The Contractor shall reasonably maintain the grass at a consistent height of between 2-3 inches long.

The Contractor shall perform edging work, to include removal of vegetation from cracks in sidewalks, driveways, parking lots, curbs, and other concrete or asphalt edges located in the improved/semi-improved grounds.

The Contractor shall apply an effective and season appropriate fertilizer on all lawns, shrubs, plants, and ground cover as frequently as determined by the Contractor as necessary to maintain a well-manicured appearance of the lot.
The Contractor will perform weed control in the gated radar shelter.
The Contractor will perform all standard maintenance to the office sprinkler system.
The contractor must provide certification or license for all employees that will be handling or applying pesticides/herbicides in performance of this Statement of Work.
A detailed technical approach write-up describing how the Quoter will perform this service is required to be submitted regardless of whether a site visit was made or not.

Past Experience. (No more than 2 / 3 pages) The quoter's past experience on related contracts should be provided to determine, as appropriate, successful performance of contract requirements, date of project start and completion (must have been completed within the last two years), quality and timeliness of delivery of goods and services, cost management, communications between contracting parties, proactive management and customer satisfaction.

THE STATEMENT OF WORK WITHIN THIS SOLICITATION MAY OR MAY NOT HAVE BEEN MODIFIED FROM THE INCUMBENT CONTRACT; THEREFORE, IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT QUOTERS THOROUGHLY REVIEW THE STATEMENT OF WORK IN THIS SOLICITATION AND MAKE A SITE VISIT.

A Schedule or Work Plan that identifies when services are to be performed shall be submitted to the MIC or designated NWS representative within seven days of the purchase order award date; see attached sample Monthly schedule.

All contractor (and subcontractor) personnel proposed to be employed under a Low Risk contract shall undergo security processing by the Department's Office of Security before being eligible to work on the premises of any Department of Commerce owned, leased, or controlled facility in the United States or overseas, or to obtain access to a Department of Commerce IT system.

The Contractor shall utilize products and material made from biobased materials to the maximum extent possible without jeopardizing the intended end use or detracting from the overall quality delivered to the end user.

matrix.quote: Biobased Products The Contractor shall utilize products and material made from biobased materials to the maximum extent possible without jeopardizing the intended end use or detracting from the overall quality delivered to the end user.

matrix.firm_answer: Firm has experience performing services at occupied federal facilities (GSA, VA, Tinker AFB) with minimal disruption.

matrix.quote: The Contractor must procure and maintain at his/her expense, all necessary permits and licenses for the conduct of operations under any order resulting from this Request for Quotation, and hereby agrees to comply with all applicable Municipal, State and Federal regulations.

matrix.evidence: Profile does not confirm Missouri business license or Missouri pesticide applicator certification.

matrix.quote: In each instance, the Contractor agrees to continue to provide sufficient personnel to perform requirements of any critical tasks already in operation or scheduled, and shall be guided by the instructions issued by the Contracting Officer or the MIC.

matrix.evidence: QC inspections logged in a CMMS; grounds maintenance experience at Tinker AFB.

matrix.evidence: Profile is silent on NAO 202-1106 sexual assault/harassment training.

matrix.firm_answer: Profile does not confirm IPP (Invoice Processing Platform) registration or prior use.

matrix.firm_answer: Firm has 38 W-2 employees performing grounds maintenance; physical capability is implied by existing federal grounds contracts.
matrix.evidence: 38 W-2 employees; Grounds maintenance, cantonment area (Tinker AFB).

matrix.quote: Period of performance shall be: Base Period is Date of Award through 02/28/2027. (Services are only provided from Date of Award-10/31/2026) Option Period 1 for a twelve month period 03/01/2027 through 02/29/2028.
matrix.firm_answer: Owner rule rc-base requires a 12-month base period. The active service window is ~2 months (award through 10/31/2026). This is a disqualifying owner-rule conflict.
matrix.evidence: Owner rule rc-base: No bids under a 12-month base period.

matrix.quote: A site visit is highly recommended but not required.
matrix.firm_answer: Site visit is recommended; firm is based in Oklahoma City (~750 miles away), making a site visit logistically costly but not mandatory.
matrix.evidence: Firm location: Oklahoma City, OK; place of performance: St. Charles, MO.

matrix.quote: Any representations and/or certifications attached to this Request for Quotation must be completed by the quoter.

matrix.quote: The contractor shall notify the contracting officer in writing within 5 business days from the date of any situation or occurrence where the contractor considers specific contract activity to be inconsistent with the intent of this contract language.
matrix.firm_answer: Standard contract administration requirement; firm has federal contract experience and can comply.
matrix.evidence: Multiple federal contracts (GSA, Tinker AFB, VA) demonstrate contract administration capability.

matrix.quote: The Contractor shall proceed diligently with performance of this contract, pending final resolution of any dispute arising under the contract.
matrix.firm_answer: Standard FAR clause; firm has multiple federal contracts demonstrating compliance with standard contract terms.
matrix.evidence: Multiple federal contracts (GSA, Tinker AFB, VA, OMES).

matrix.evidence: Green cleaning program listed in capabilities; specific USDA BioPreferred product data sheets not confirmed.
